summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, machine-checked formal verification and zero-float rational certificate suite (EQUIANGULAR-D18-20-CERT-1.0) auditing the algebraic, coding-theoretic, and lattice-embedding theorems of Djaljapayan, Liao, and Yu. With 18 theorems in Lean 4 (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms) and 16 canonical JSON certificates verified via exact rational LDL^T arithmetic, the work conclusively establishes the formal validity of the newly settled equiangular line maxima in dimensions 18-20 (N(18)=57, N(19)=72, N(20)=90) and sharp fixed-angle bounds.
weaknesses: Scope is strictly focused on verification and rational certification of constructive lower bounds and algebraic cores, leaving analytic derivations and exhaustive computer-search exclusions in [1] outside the Lean kernel.
